title: Libby agent run-log row
description: One row per agent invocation, appended to data/cases/<slug>/runs.jsonl. This is the provenance/audit trail read by scripts/check_pipeline.py to prove every required stage (and both board rounds) ran. Rows carry arbitrary agent-specific telemetry beyond the pinned fields, so additionalProperties is permitted; only `agent` (and `round` for board personas) is constrained.

agent.description: Canonical agent id, matching the .claude/agents/<name>.md filename. Casing is significant: the synthesis agent is `PI`, not `pi`.

round.description: For the five board personas this is 1 (initial positions) or 2 (cross-critiques); check_pipeline.py enforces that. Some non-board agents historically logged a free-text stage label here (e.g. 'synthesis'), so the shape is left permissive and the [1,2] rule is enforced semantically per-persona rather than in-schema.
